entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi... um, I hope you can help. I bought some cycling shoes about a month ago, and I need to return them. The website is just so confusing.

I can certainly look into that return for you. To start, could I get your order number? And just to be sure, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, I don't know the order number offhand. They just... they're not right. I tried to set up the cleats and went for one ride, and I got terrible blisters. I just want a refund. The whole process is overwhelming. Can't you just help me?

Of course, I can help. I'm sorry to hear the shoes caused blisters. I can look up your order with your email address instead. One moment please... Okay, I see your order here. It was delivered 35 days ago.
Yes, that sounds right. Is that too long? I wasn't sure what the policy was.
Not at all. For our standard items, like these cycling shoes, we have a 90-day return policy. You are well within that timeframe. I can go ahead and process this return for you right now.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! So I can get a full refund?

That's correct. I've just initiated the return and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file. Just package the shoes up, attach the label, and drop them off. Once we receive them, your refund will be processed.
Wow, thank you so much, Charlie. I was so worried it was going to be a problem. You've made this very easy.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
